title: Documented CLI install crashes on stories save-version: Markus is only an optional dependency
description: docs/cli-login.md tells people to run pipx install papyrus-newsroom. That installs no anthus-markus, because pyproject lists it only under the markus extra. stories save-version checks the body through papyrus_content/markus_renderer/derive.py, which imports markusmd, so the command dies with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'markusmd'. Seen on 5.83.0 on 2026-11-04 saving a Story outline on Machines on Machines. Saving a draft is a core newsroom command, so anything the base CLI imports for it belongs in base dependencies. Proposed fix: move anthus-markus into dependencies, keep Pillow and boto3 in the extra unless they are also needed, and add a test that runs save-version from a clean install without extras. Workaround: pip install 'papyrus-newsroom[markus]'.
